en.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

zhSimplified.text: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

zhTraditional.text: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。

en.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

zhSimplified.text: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。

en.text: For through the LORD’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己的面前赶出。

zhTraditional.text: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己的面前趕出。

en.text: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

zhSimplified.text: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。

zhTraditional.text: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。

en.text: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

zhSimplified.text: 于是城被围困直到西底家王十一年。

zhTraditional.text: 於是城被圍困直到西底家王十一年。

en.text: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。

zhTraditional.text: 四月初九日，城裏有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。

en.text: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

zhSimplified.text: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四围攻城。他们就往亚拉巴逃去。

zhTraditional.text: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四圍攻城。他們就往亞拉巴逃去。

en.text: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底的军队追赶西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全軍都離開他四散了。

en.text: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在哈马地利比拉的巴比伦王那里；巴比伦王便审判他。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在哈馬地利比拉的巴比倫王那裏；巴比倫王便審判他。

en.text: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又在利比拉杀了犹大的一切首领，

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，又在利比拉殺了猶大的一切首領，

en.text: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

zhSimplified.text: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去，将他囚在监里，直到他死的日子。 （王下25·8—17）

zhTraditional.text: 並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖着他，帶到巴比倫去，將他囚在監裏，直到他死的日子。 （王下25‧8－17）

en.text: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比伦王面前侍立的护卫长尼布撒拉旦进入耶路撒冷，

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比倫王面前侍立的護衛長尼布撒拉旦進入耶路撒冷，

en.text: He burned the LORD’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。

zhTraditional.text: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。

en.text: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

zhSimplified.text: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。

zhTraditional.text: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。

en.text: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的和城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。

zhTraditional.text: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將民中最窮的和城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。

en.text: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

zhSimplified.text: 但护卫长尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。

zhTraditional.text: 但護衛長尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。

en.text: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华殿的铜柱并殿内的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華殿的銅柱並殿內的盆座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，

en.text: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

zhSimplified.text: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、盘子、调羹，并所用的一切铜器、

zhTraditional.text: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、盤子、調羹，並所用的一切銅器、

en.text: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

zhSimplified.text: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、灯台、调羹、爵，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。

zhTraditional.text: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、燈臺、調羹、爵，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。

en.text: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for the LORD’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根铜柱、一个铜海，并座下的十二只铜牛，这一切的铜多得无法可称。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根銅柱、一個銅海，並座下的十二隻銅牛，這一切的銅多得無法可稱。

en.text: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

footnotes.text: 52:21 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

zhSimplified.text: 这一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，围十二肘。

zhTraditional.text: 這一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，圍十二肘。

en.text: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

footnotes.text: 52:22 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

zhSimplified.text: 柱上有铜顶，高五肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子照此一样，也有石榴。

zhTraditional.text: 柱上有銅頂，高五肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子照此一樣，也有石榴。

en.text: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

zhSimplified.text: 柱子四面有九十六个石榴，在网子周围，共有一百石榴。 （王下25·18—21，27—30）

zhTraditional.text: 柱子四面有九十六個石榴，在網子周圍，共有一百石榴。 （王下25‧18－21，27－30）

en.text: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

zhSimplified.text: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，

zhTraditional.text: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，

en.text: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

zhSimplified.text: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官，并在城里所遇常见王面的七个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里所遇见的国民六十个人。

zhTraditional.text: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官，並在城裏所遇常見王面的七個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裏所遇見的國民六十個人。

en.text: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

zhSimplified.text: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到利比拉的巴比伦王那里。

zhTraditional.text: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。

en.text: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。

en.text: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

zhSimplified.text: 尼布甲尼撒所掳的民数记在下面：在他第七年掳去犹大人三千零二十三名；

zhTraditional.text: 尼布甲尼撒所擄的民數記在下面：在他第七年擄去猶大人三千零二十三名；

en.text: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

zhSimplified.text: 尼布甲尼撒十八年从耶路撒冷掳去八百三十二人；

zhTraditional.text: 尼布甲尼撒十八年從耶路撒冷擄去八百三十二人；

en.text: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.

zhSimplified.text: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦掳去犹大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。

zhTraditional.text: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，護衛長尼布撒拉旦擄去猶大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。

en.text: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未·米罗达元年十二月二十五日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监，

zhTraditional.text: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未‧米羅達元年十二月二十五日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監，

en.text: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

zhSimplified.text: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，

zhTraditional.text: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，

en.text: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.

zhSimplified.text: 给他脱了囚服。他终身在巴比伦王面前吃饭。

zhTraditional.text: 給他脫了囚服。他終身在巴比倫王面前吃飯。

en.text: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身是这样，直到他死的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身是這樣，直到他死的日子。
